description:
The companies a portfolio owns through its funds, added up across funds. In: holdings. Out:
        the largest companies with their share of the whole portfolio, companies reached
        through more than one fund, the part of the money that buys a company a second time,
        sectors, and how much of the money could be named. Typical questions: 'How much do
        my ETFs overlap?'; 'What companies do I really own through VTI, QQQ and VXUS?'; 'How
        much NVIDIA do I hold through my funds?'. Instead: for one fund on its own,
        asset_info. Figures are minimums where a fund shows only its largest holdings; the
        answer says how much of the money is named. It does not recommend, predict or
        calculate tax.

base.description: Currency code every figure is expressed in: USD, EUR, GBP, CAD… Default USD.
base.title: Base

holdings.description: What is held: {ticker: number}, 1 to 100 holdings. Weights in any scale (60/20/20 or 0.6/0.2/0.2) or money amounts in the base currency (60000/20000/20000): holdings adding up to 1 or 100 are read as percentages, anything else as money, which makes the falls come out in money. Tickers as the exchange lists them (VOO, VWCE.DE, EQQQ.DE, XAW.TO; 'CASH.USD' for cash). Example: {"VTI": 60, "VXUS": 20, "BND": 20}.
holdings.title: Holdings

name: look_through

outputSchema.description: What the portfolio owns through its funds.

_fence.description: What these figures are and are not: descriptive, no forecast, no advice. Repeat its sense when presenting the result.

covered_fraction.description: Share of the money whose underlying holdings are visible, 0 to 1.

data.description: Where the prices came from and what was missing or repaired.

as_of.description: Last date of price history used.

missing.description: Tickers with no usable history (left out).

standins.description: Holdings measured through a stand-in with longer history: ticker, proxy, index, from, until, evidence.

duplicated_exposure.description: Share held more than once through different funds.

exposures.description: [company, share of the whole portfolio] pairs, largest first.

opaque.description: Holdings with no breakdown to look through.

refused.description: Funds whose breakdown the data vendor refused.

top_symbol_weight.description: Its share of the whole portfolio.

title: What the funds hold underneath
